note.en: The moon rises from the churned ocean of milk and is seized by Mahadeva (Shiva), who wears it as an ornament.

note.en: At Skanda's anointing as commander of the celestial forces, Rudra honours him so openly that Skanda becomes known as 'the son of Rudra.'
